name: Apartment Ebster
beschreibung: The Apartment Ebster is located in the centre of Pettneu am Arlberg, just a few minutes' walk from the ski bus stop. The holiday apartment offers functional furnishings with a separate living area and a small kitchenette. Guests can reach the St. Anton am Arlberg ski area in about ten minutes by bus. In the village there is a grocery store and an inn.
